hotspots.title: AI Powered turbidity sensing
hotspots.text: The AI Powered Turbidity Sensing, intelligently detects detergent residue during the wash cycle and removes up to 50%* more of it. This ensures a cleaner wash while keeping fabrics soft and gentle on the skin—so you enjoy truly clean clothes.

hotspots.title: Refresh cycle
hotspots.text: Uses steam to deodorize and refresh clothes. Helpful for lightly worn clothes which don’t need washing.

hotspots.title: Digi inverter motor
hotspots.text: The advanced Digital Inverter Motor delivers powerful, energy-efficient washes with minimal noise and vibration. Built to last longer with less maintenance, it ensures reliable performance for years.

hotspots.title: FabriSafe™ drum
hotspots.text: Multiple coin sized grooves reduce friction while scrubbing. Cleans clothes while taking care of fabric quality.
